title: Remove custom Q&A feature and enable general health question answering

requirements.text: Remove the custom Q&A tab and management UI from the assistant panel interface
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Custom Q&A' tab is no longer visible in the assistant panel
Users cannot add, edit, or delete custom Q&A pairs through the UI

requirements.text: Remove custom Q&A matching logic from the assistant brain command interpreter
acceptanceCriteria: Custom Q&A pairs are not checked or matched during user input processing
Fuzzy matching for custom Q&A is removed from the command flow
The assistant no longer returns custom Q&A pair responses

requirements.text: Expand the medical knowledge base to cover a comprehensive range of general health topics beyond the current curated list

quotes: make the chat can literally answer any question about health issues

acceptanceCriteria: The knowledge base includes information on common health conditions, symptoms, preventive care, nutrition, exercise, mental health, medications, and general wellness topics
The assistant can provide relevant responses to a wide variety of health questions
Fallback responses are provided for questions outside the knowledge base scope with appropriate disclaimers

requirements.text: Improve the assistant's pattern matching to handle diverse health-related queries with better fuzzy matching and synonym recognition

quotes: make the chat can literally answer any question about health issues

acceptanceCriteria: The assistant recognizes variations and synonyms of health terms (e.g., 'hypertension' and 'high blood pressure')
Fuzzy matching threshold is optimized for natural health questions
Users receive relevant responses even when questions are phrased differently

requirements.text: Add a general health question handler that provides helpful responses when no specific medical topic is matched

quotes: make the chat can literally answer any question about health issues

acceptanceCriteria: When a health question doesn't match any specific topic, the assistant provides a general helpful response
The fallback response includes a disclaimer about consulting healthcare professionals
The assistant encourages users to rephrase or provides suggestions for related topics

constraints: Do not modify the backend Motoko code
Preserve the existing assistant speech recognition and text-to-speech functionality
Keep the Design B theme system intact
nonGoals: Integrating external AI/LLM services for question answering
Adding real-time medical data from external APIs
Modifying the report upload and management features
